steps.note: Start the eRFX project creation flow.
Set the requested project title.
Configure the project with an RFQ stage only.
Apply the RFQ template and line items to the RFQ stage.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template.
Add one CYLINDER product and set its requested quantity to 10.

args.goal: on the RFQ create screen, set the line item's delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Add T&Cs, add the clauses "Payment within 45 days" and "Delivery within 7 days" with both modes set to None and mandatory terms left unticked, click Done, and stop on the create screen showing the configured event

steps.note: Configure the requested delivery location and project-level optional terms, which have no dedicated catalog step.
Confirm the event contains exactly one line item.
Commit the 30-minute schedule before publishing.
Invite one QA test vendor to the RFQ.
Publish the configured eRFX project.
Confirm publishing reached a real project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event's RFQ pricing round and its bid sheet.
Accept the available terms and submit a quote of 100 for the line item.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the bid as submitted.
Return to the buyer's event page.
Open the buyer-side overview where project-level terms may be displayed.
Confirm the first project-level clause is visible on the buyer side.
Confirm the second project-level clause is visible on the buyer side.
